$comment: The calibration switches, at their healthy settings, and the named builds. Each switch keeps the meaning it has in ai-playtest's calibration/game.mjs, so its answer key carries over. 'baseline' is healthy everywhere; each mutant flips one switch (refusal has two); 'bleak' flips every switch except reacts, because a build that ignores input would hide the rest, and 'deaf' covers that one alone.
